name: Taiga Aoi
source:
Favorite Food: Protein
Wandering High School Boy Singer-Songwriter Tiger Seaweed

A delinquent who has more brawn than brains. He acts pretty reckless most of the time and he skips school whenever he can. His hobby is playing basketball with his best friend Genki.
His mother owns a small green grocer where he often helps out after school, he's a popular guy in the marketplace.
When he was a kid he dreamed of becoming a hero, he's actually a passionate and nice guy who wants to protect the protagonist.
